name: Gaetano Ferlaino
bioAdditions: Gaetano married Candida Colosimo on 22 December 1743 (S1). He is called son of the late Nicola, which supports the tree's Nicola Ferraino (b. 1675, from Martirano) as his father.

relationships.evidence: Marriage names father the late Nicola

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).
